title: Explicit cgroup-v2 hierarchy and resource limits for VM isolation

deliverables.description: CgroupSpec (serde) with cpu_quota_us, cpu_period_us (default 100000), memory_max_bytes, memory_swap_max_bytes (default 0), pids_max, optional io_max; validating CgroupSpecBuilder; Controller enum (cpu/memory/pids/io) with std::str::FromStr; IoMax with kernel-format io.max line rendering; pure check_required_controllers -> CgroupUnavailable; validate_subtree_control_empty and validate_no_children leaf-contract checks -> InvalidResourceSpec; exact cpu.max/memory.max/memory.swap.max/pids.max value renderers

CgroupManager: configurable root + parent name; parent/leaf path computation; top-down controller delegation (create_parent writes +cpu +memory +pids +io to root and parent cgroup.subtree_control); per-VM create_leaf; apply_spec (validate -> check parent controllers -> create leaf -> write all limit files) failing closed before any write; read_back round-trip into AppliedLimits with matches_spec; verify_leaf (exists, no children, empty subtree_control); idempotent teardown_leaf; JailerCommand whose argv() always emits --cgroup-version=2 and --parent-cgroup <pre-created leaf>; missing root/controller mapped to CgroupUnavailable
Crate docs, module wiring, re-exports, and two deterministic end-to-end tests (full isolation lifecycle in a tempdir; missing-io-controller fails closed with no leaf created)

Privileged integration test gated behind #[cfg(feature = "privileged")]; runs against a real unified /sys/fs/cgroup on a capable host and reports a stable `blocked` token (not a failure) when cgroup2 is missing or delegation is permission-denied; always tears down any cgroup it creates and never spawns Firecracker
Crate manifest with `privileged` feature, deps on microvm-types/microvm-errors/serde, dev-deps serde_json/tempfile

cargo_test.details: 33 spec tests (builder defaults/overrides/missing-required, zero-field validation, rendered kernel file values, io.max line format, required-controllers with/without io, controller name roundtrip, parse_controllers dedup/unknown, controller availability checks, leaf subtree_control/no-children constraints, serde roundtrip + omit-absent-io + deserialize-then-validate) + 13 manager tests (paths, require_root missing/present, apply_spec write+read-back round-trip with/without io, invalid-spec and missing-controller and missing-root rejected before write, create_parent top-down delegation, create_leaf requires parent, verify_leaf ok/children/nonempty-subtree/missing, idempotent teardown, jailer argv includes --cgroup-version=2 and --parent-cgroup, extra args ordered after cgroup flags) + 2 lib end-to-end tests

privileged_test.details: host has a real unified cgroup2 hierarchy (controllers: cpuset cpu io memory hugetlb pids rdma misc dmem); test detected it, attempted top-down delegation, and correctly reported `blocked: cgroup_delegate_failed ... permission denied` (non-root) then passed — the intended pass/blocked/failed semantics. On a root-capable self-hosted runner the same test enforces cpu/memory/pids and reads the values back from the kernel files.

cargo_fmt.details: cargo fmt --all -- --check exit 0 (format_strings rustfmt option is nightly-only and pre-existing; harmless warning)

cargo_clippy.details: clean across all workspace crates and targets; also clean with -p microvm-isolation --all-targets --features privileged -- -D warnings

workspace_regression.details: all pre-existing crates (types, errors, lifecycle, transport-contract, artifacts) still green; workspace test exit 0

security_fixtures.missing_cgroup_root: pass - require_root/apply_spec return ErrorCode::CgroupUnavailable before any spawn or write
security_fixtures.missing_required_controller: pass - check_parent_controllers/apply_spec return CgroupUnavailable with missing=memory (or io) in context; no leaf created
security_fixtures.io_required_only_when_spec_has_io: pass - io added to required controllers only when io_max is set; missing io fails closed
security_fixtures.leaf_must_have_no_children: pass - verify_leaf/validate_no_children return InvalidResourceSpec with children in context
security_fixtures.leaf_empty_subtree_control: pass - non-empty cgroup.subtree_control rejected with InvalidResourceSpec (no domain controllers in a leaf subtree)
security_fixtures.invalid_spec_rejected_before_write: pass - zero cpu_quota/cpu_period/memory_max/pids_max and missing required builder fields all yield InvalidResourceSpec; no leaf created
security_fixtures.jailer_argv_contract: pass - argv always contains --cgroup-version=2 and --parent-cgroup pointing at the pre-created root-relative leaf path; extra flags ordered after cgroup flags
security_fixtures.configured_values_roundtrip: pass - apply_spec then read_back matches_spec for cpu.max/memory.max/memory.swap.max/pids.max and optional io.max

qa_scenarios.happy: cargo test -p microvm-isolation tests::end_to_end_isolation_lifecycle -> 1 passed (create_parent -> apply_spec -> verify_leaf -> read_back matches -> jailer argv references pre-created leaf -> teardown)
qa_scenarios.happy_privileged: cargo test --features privileged --test cgroup_v2 -- --nocapture -> 1 passed (blocked on non-root host; enforces+reads back on a capable root host)
qa_scenarios.failure: cargo test -p microvm-isolation tests::end_to_end_missing_io_controller_fails_closed -> 1 passed (CgroupUnavailable, missing=io, zero leaves created)

CgroupUnavailable: missing required controller (cpu/memory/pids, or io when io_max set)
I/O error reading/writing any cgroup control file

feature_gates.privileged: gates tests/cgroup_v2.rs (real /sys/fs/cgroup creation/teardown); excluded from the default deterministic run so CI runs without root

not_tested: live privileged cgroup creation/teardown against a writable /sys/fs/cgroup as root (the gated test reports `blocked` on this non-root host; it enforces and reads back on a capable self-hosted runner)
real io.max enforcement against a live block device (io.max line format and round-trip are verified deterministically; kernel-side throttling is out of scope for this task)
